name: list_containers
summary: List outermost holders with at least one item (lockers, crates, machines, a backpack on the floor) not held by a player: slots used, item totals, position, nearest first or by reference id. 12 per page. Read only.

help.text: A holder inside another (a crate in a lander, a box in a locker) is not listed alone: its items count toward the outermost holder, and the filters match that holder. Look inside with container_contents or find_items within_id. Empty containers are not listed.
help.keys: containers [{reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, slot_count, used_slot_count, item_count, items, position, ...}], count, total, offset, limit, has_more, local_player {reference_id, display_name, position}.

prefab_contains.description: Part of the container's prefab name, any case ('Locker', 'Crate').

name_contains.description: Part of the container's shown name (its label), any case.

near_player_m.description: Only containers within this many metres of the player.

x-paging.order: order nearest (default): nearest the player first (no position last), then prefab name, then reference id; order reference_id: lowest reference id first
